incidents.name: Paribus
incidents.notes: Attacker inflates PBX price on Camelot, mints an overvalued V3 LP-NFT collateral, and borrows against its manipulated spot valuation.

sources.ref: deployment-basis recheck: Compound-fork delegator whose logic pointer is storage slot 18. The victim DELEGATECALLs 0x738b6098bf382b810f2d915f44e940bef62a3659 for every selector in the attack (borrow, getAccountSnapshot, ...), which is the value held in slot 18 at both the creation block 96328739 and the incident block 296699667 with no intervening write; the delegator runtime is byte-identical at both blocks and no NewImplementation or EIP-1967 event was emitted. Deployment is the correct basis; 598.0 days.

incidents.name: Paribus pETH redeem reentrancy
incidents.notes: The Paribus native-ETH market sent ether to the redeemer before the comptroller's collateral bookkeeping was updated, so the receive hook re-entered the protocol and borrowed against collateral that had already been withdrawn.

sources.ref: onchain review: pETH 0x375Ae76F0450293e50876D0e5bDC3022CAb23198 created 2023-03-27T15:21:40Z by 0x8acd5764d8edef0558dbdf40ae64c7ffb6531160, not the attack-tx sender 0x014abff04e5c441b2ceaa62d843bbc5ae49e5504. Compound-fork delegator, so NewImplementation(address,address) logs were queried in addition to EIP-1967: the only one is at the creation block 74259357, so the executing code was 14.8 days old. Loss ~86k per the DeFiHackLabs 2023 index entry for this PoC. Distinct from the 2025-01 Paribus row already in this file. Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim is a Compound-fork PEtherDelegator keeping its implementation in plain storage slot 18; a binary search of eth_getStorageAt on slot 18 over [74259357, 79308098] finds 0x5b0ec471565e36e5a33c35b861dd752e16f3a8e7 unchanged from creation to the incident, the delegator runtime is byte-identical at both blocks, and that implementation contains no DELEGATECALL, so deployment is the right basis.
